title: Review workflow: build as the runner user into a writable build-out
summary: The review workflow's build job no longer compiles osf inside the read-only checkout. It creates a `build-out` directory owned by the runner, mounts the base checkout read-only, and runs the build container as the runner's uid/gid with `CARGO_HOME` and `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` redirected into that writable mount. The work-item step then runs the freshly built binary from the read-only `build-out` mount, and every job that mounts `out` writable now chmods it for the image user. A new integration test file pins these invariants: read-only `/base` mounts, a writable `build-out`, the runner user on every container, and no provider secrets in the build job.

nodes.label: Runner workspace
nodes.subtitle: ${{ github.workspace }}
nodes.summary: The host directory holding `base`, `build-out`, `work-item` and `out`. The build job now creates `build-out` here before any container starts.

nodes.label: build-out
nodes.subtitle: writable build output
nodes.summary: A runner-owned directory created by `mkdir build-out`. It is mounted writable into the build container and read-only into the work-item container, and holds the cargo home, target dir and final binary.

nodes.label: base checkout
nodes.subtitle: /base, read-only
nodes.summary: The base branch checkout. Every container mount of `/base` is now `:ro`, so no container can write into the source tree.

nodes.label: out
nodes.subtitle: review output, chmod a+rwX
nodes.summary: The review output directory mounted writable into several jobs. Each such job now runs `chmod -R a+rwX out` so the image user can write into it.

nodes.label: cargo build container
nodes.subtitle: docker run --user $(id -u):$(id -g)
nodes.summary: Runs `cargo build --release --bin osf` as the runner user, with `/base` read-only and `/build-out` writable, and `CARGO_HOME`/`CARGO_TARGET_DIR` pointed into the writable mount.

nodes.label: work-item container
nodes.subtitle: osf review work-item
nodes.summary: Runs the built binary from the read-only `build-out` mount as the runner user, reading the pull request JSON from `work-item`.

nodes.label: review jobs
nodes.subtitle: out mounted writable
nodes.summary: The jobs that mount `out` writable now chmod it for the image user before running the binary.

nodes.label: osf binary
nodes.subtitle: build-out/target/release/osf
nodes.summary: The release binary produced by the build container. It now lives under `build-out` rather than `base/target`, and is uploaded as the `osf-binary` artifact from that path.

nodes.label: osf-binary artifact
nodes.subtitle: actions/upload-artifact
nodes.summary: The uploaded artifact now points at `build-out/target/release/osf`, matching the new build output location.

nodes.label: review_workflow tests
nodes.subtitle: crates/osf/tests/review_workflow.rs
nodes.summary: Five new tests parse the workflow text and assert the build job's user, mounts and env vars, the read-only `/base` mounts, the chmod on writable `out` mounts, and that the build job reads no provider secrets.

edges.summary: Jobs that mount `out` writable now chmod it so the image user can write review output.
